name: ai-ghost-row
title: AiGhostRow
description: An AI-generated example shown inline and visibly unconfirmed, with Accept, Edit and Reject.

a11y.pattern: <div role="group" aria-label="AI suggestion: <name>"> with native buttons
keyboard: Moves between Accept, Edit and Reject
aria: Buttons are named "Accept <name>", "Edit <name>", "Reject <name>" through visually hidden text
The unconfirmed state is written ("Generated by AI, review needed"), not only dashed and colored
busy sets aria-busy and disables the actions
a11y.notes: An AI row is never counted or exported until accepted: that rule belongs to the page, not to this component.
